exits.take2x: sell all at 2× (a 1-min bar high touches 2×)
exits.take2x_close: sell all at 2× only on a 1-min CLOSE ≥ 2× (filled at that close)
exits.half3x: sell half at 3×, hold the rest to the close
exits.stop50: stop at −50%, else hold to the close
exits.stop50_take2x: stop at −50% / sell all at 2×, whichever first
exits.level_stop: out when the underlying closes back through the trigger level by > 0.05% (sold at the next option print), else hold
exits.level_stop_take2x: level stop / sell all at 2×, whichever first
